latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release integrating Google Search Console management via ClawLink.

- Query search performance, URL indexing status, and sitemap information from chat.
- Manage verified Search Console sites directly through the integration.
- Guided setup: install ClawLink plugin, pair device, and connect Google Search Console — no manual API configuration required.
- Uses ClawLink’s dynamic tool discovery; all operations require confirmation where appropriate.
- Secure handling: never collects raw credentials; directs users to ClawLink-hosted flows.
